firm_data.firm_description: Sitaras & Associates, PLLC is a boutique law firm based in New York that advises and represents businesses and individuals in litigation, dispute resolution, and business deals. The firm offers legal counsel to corporates, businesses, founders, and entrepreneurs.
notable_facts: Sitaras & Associates, PLLC represents clients in the United States and abroad, with affiliations to lawyers and firms in Athens, Greece, and Milan, Italy.

email.subject: AI for Sitaras & Associates, PLLC
email.body:
Hi George,

Since founding Sitaras & Associates in 2014, you've built a boutique practice that handles complex commercial litigation and corporate transactions with just seven attorneys. That lean team model is exactly why we started Lucio.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency without the overhead.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms in New York. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on the commercial litigation and transactional side.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
